name: QTT Product
description: One row per QTT SaaS product (QMP LMS, future QTT HRMS, future QTT CRM, ...). The platform itself never hardcodes a product's identity anywhere else — every product-aware doctype and function refers to a product only via this doctype's name. See the QTT SaaS Platform architecture document, section 6.

fields.label: Product Key
fields.description: Stable identifier, e.g. QMP_LMS, QTT_HRMS. Uppercase letters, digits, and underscores only — enforced in validate(). Never changes after creation; this is what every other doctype's `product` Link field points at.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: disabled locks out every tenant for this product in one change, regardless of individual QTT Product Access rows — see the hardening review section 3.

fields.label: Frappe App
fields.description: The installed Frappe app that implements this product, e.g. 'lms'.

fields.label: Roles
fields.description: The product's own vocabulary for QTT Product Access.product_role — the platform validates a Product Access row's role against this list, never hardcodes what a valid role is.
